title: Introduce the editor on first open: popup help, don't show again, connect your AI first (2026-10-29)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Then we need to be able to introduce the editor. 
Opening a new editor should probably have a popup help (and a way to say don't show again) 

The editor is not something people are used to. It needs some key concepts and tools explained. 
One of the first things it should explain is how to connect claude code or chatgpt.
